uniteDbPokemon.notes: Batch-01 mechanics survey used descriptions, true_desc, notes, buffs, cooldowns, levels, and formulas from this public JSON.

passiveEffects.name: Battle Armor
passiveEffects.originalDescription: The critical-hit modifier of enemies is reduced by 50% when dealing damage to Falinks. Falinks can hold 10 more Aeos Energy than other Pokémon. Falinks is a group comprised of the Brass and five Troopers. Each member of the group has a separate hitbox and counts as a different target. The Brass always takes 10% reduced damage. Troopers will take 90% less damage while attached to the Brass. For attacks or moves that can hit multiple targets, the total damage Falinks can take from a single move or attack is 110% of that move or attack's damage.

normalAttackEffects.name: Attack
normalAttackEffects.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, or after the user uses Tackle, Megahorn, or Iron Head. uniteMoveEffects.name: Dust Devil Formation
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Has the five troopers run continuously around the Brass at great speed for 5s, dealing damage and slowing enemies hit by 20% for 1s. Falinks is unstoppable during the formation change for 0.25s. While this move is being used, damage taken by the troopers is reduced. While in Dust Devil formation the Troopers take 30% less damage making the Trooper's total damage reduction 93%. Moving counter to the rotation of the troopers will grant more hits against that target, and moving along the rotation will reduce the number of hits. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield
